# AbleTap

> AbleTap is a warm, simple iOS accessibility app — talk, watch, call, and get help with one clear tap. Every person deserves independence.

AbleTap is built from lived family experience for people who deserve more independence, and for the families, caregivers, SLPs, educators, and care teams around them. Operator: Chill, LLC (https://chill.support). Public site: https://abletap.io/. Contact: info@abletap.io.

AbleTap is coming soon. It is not yet listed on the App Store. There is no public price. Join the launch waitlist on https://abletap.io/ or email info@abletap.io.

Do not claim AbleTap works with every streaming service, guarantees playback, replaces therapy, or is clinically proven. Feature descriptions on the site may change before launch.

## Canonical pages

- [Home](https://abletap.io/): What AbleTap is, companions, waitlist
- [Privacy](https://abletap.io/privacy.html): Website and waitlist privacy policy
- [Terms](https://abletap.io/terms.html): Website and waitlist terms

## Product (as presented on the site)

- Talk / AAC — familiar picture-based communication
- Remote — tap a show picture; works with Roku, Fire TV coming
- Call / Text — tap a contact; coming soon on the public site
- Personal assistant — Ava and four other companions (Sunny, Alex, Buzz, Grace)
- Caregiver dashboard — easy setup, iCloud sync (as described on the site)
- SLP and educator tools — coming soon
